articles.title: Man Utd: Michael Carrick dismisses ‘ridiculous’ speculation over his future
articles.summary: Manchester United boss Michael Carrick says talk of his future is “not on his radar” and insists their recent setbacks are far from a “catastrophe”; watch Fulham vs Man Utd on Sunday, live on Sky Sports Premier League from 4pm; kick-off 4.30pm
articles.body:
Days after a controversial 1-0 home defeat by rivals Manchester City, United surrendered a two-goal lead to crash out of the Carabao Cup with a 3-2 loss to Brighton at Old Trafford, as boos rang out from the Stretford End while Carrick and his players trudged off the pitch.

With just four points from their opening four Premier League games, United need a win at Fulham on Sunday to avoid heading into the international break under mounting pressure, with the familiar feeling that another season could already be slipping away.

But Carrick has called for perspective after back-to-back defeats have put him under pressure just weeks into the season.

"It's not a catastrophe or a disaster," said Carrick. "It's not the end of the world. We're not in the place where we've gone on an awful long run of horrific results, you know?

"We've lost a couple of games recently and we feel like we've started and we've been in all the games that we've played, if not been the better team at the start of games, so it's not like we're having a real struggle all the time.

"We've done a lot of good things in them to put ourselves in really good positions in the games we've been in, so the belief certainly comes from that.

"Of the good things that we've done, that gets totally lost in some ways in the surrounding feeling, but it doesn't get lost by us."

Carrick won 12 of his 17 games in charge last season, but United have already suffered defeat to newly promoted Hull this campaign, been pegged back twice in a 2-2 draw at Everton, and fallen to a City side that had Phil Foden sent off in the 23rd minute last weekend.

Wednesday's defeat to Brighton was the first time United had lost at home after taking a 2-0 lead since 1976.

"History tells you that any team that's successful goes through periods when you have to come through it and improve," Carrick added. "We've had a small period when it hasn't been exactly what we want it to be.

"I was expecting a point when we would go through it, it was going to come. There was going to be a time when you don't get everything out of it that you want. It's how you work through it, how you react, keep doing the right things and believe you will come through it."

Since taking charge last January, Carrick has maintained a calm demeanour and this week insisted that the pressure does not affect him.

Asked if the X-rated chants coming from the Stretford End on Wednesday night hurt on a personal level, Carrick said: "We don't like losing matches. It's not like I don't feel the emotion, but it doesn't affect what we do next."

Bookmakers have reflected the growing scrutiny on Carrick by cutting the odds on him losing his job before Christmas, but the 45-year-old insisted the prospect has not crossed his mind.

"In terms of the future and the [club] ownership and how long I've got, it's ridiculous to think that way in the position I'm in," he said. "It's just not on the radar."

Carrick hits back at criticism of Man Utd's style

Carrick's approach has come under staunch criticism following United's recent struggles. They rank among the teams covering the least distance and recording the fewest sprints, a statistic that has been reflected in a number of uninspiring performances.

United have also struggled when dominating possession, with their results suggesting they have often picked up more points when they have less of the ball. Asked about their difficulties in possession, Carrick told Sky Sports :

"I don't think it's a major deal, really. We are capable of playing in different ways; I think we've shown that. From last season, when we came in, playing a certain way, we ended up scoring a lot of goals. We've scored a good number of goals this season in different ways.

"The beauty of it is we can play different styles; we've done that already this season, in different ways. You always try to have as many strings and weapons as you can."

Carrick also places little emphasis on having a defined style of play, suggesting that the difficulty opponents have in reading United's intentions can be an advantage.

"I quite like the fact that someone can't work out our identity, to be honest," Carrick added.

"That means you're unpredictable. From an attacking sense, we want to be unpredictable. We don't want people to be able to read what we are going to do next or what our main strength is. If we can do a good number of things well and attack from a number of areas, I'd rather have a team that does that.

"We've attacked well since January, scored a good number of goals and being unpredictable is a good thing."

Watch the full interview on Premier League Weekend live from 10am, on Saturday.

Watch Fulham vs Man Utd on Sunday, live on Sky Sports Premier League from 4pm; kick-off 4.30pm.

articles.title: Lane Kiffin Reportedly Wants LSU to 'Embarrass' Ole Miss in Return to Oxford for CFB Revenge Game
articles.summary: LSU head coach Lane Kiffin reportedly wants more than just a revenge victory when his team faces his old one in Ole Miss on Saturday.
articles.body:
LSU head coach Lane Kiffin reportedly wants more than just a revenge victory when his team faces his old one in Ole Miss on Saturday.

"He doesn't just want to beat these guys," one LSU source told Chris Low of On3. "He wants to embarrass them, and he wants the heat, wants every bit of it."

There will surely be plenty of "heat" waiting for him at Ole Miss.

5 Teams That Can Crash the CFB Playoff 🏈

Kiffin coached the Rebels to the College Football Playoff last season but left to take the head coaching job with LSU before the start of the postseason. While he publicly made it known he wanted to remain there to coach in the CFP, Ole Miss decided against it.

"Ole Miss doesn't want Kiffin around its players with the transfer portal opening on Jan. 2," ESPN's Mark Schlabach and Pete Thamel reported at the time. "The Rebels also don't want their CFP games to be a 'commercial' for LSU's future under Kiffin."

The Rebels ended up reaching the semifinals without him and are once again positioned to challenge for a title this season if the early rankings are any indication.

They are No. 8 in the country, while LSU is No. 7. The winner of Saturday's showdown will have a major building block for their resume in both the SEC race and the overall CFP picture as the season progresses.

Still, Kiffin's return is even overshadowing the on-field storylines.

The Mississippi Department of Public Safety ann ounced there will be enhanced law enforcement presence for the game, while Ole Miss sent a message to its students saying it will not allow anyone with LSU gear to sit in the student section.

For his part, Kiffin wants his players to focus on the game.

"I guess there's real safety issues and stuff, so there's people that have a plan for that," he told reporters . "I told the players today, 'Man, you don't have anything to worry about as far as, like, attention on you all week and everything. There's going to be so much attention, hatred, everything on me. You just get to go play.'"

Going out and playing is the only way the Tigers will be able to get the blowout victory Kiffin is reportedly looking for Saturday.

articles.title: New Brian Kelly Rumors Update Buzz on Potential Landing Spot for Former Notre Dame, LSU HC
articles.summary: Rutgers football coach Greg Schiano landing on the hot seat could potentially create an opening for the return for former LSU coach Brian Kelly, The Athletic's Bruce Feldman reported Friday.
articles.body:
Rutgers football coach Greg Schiano landing on the hot seat could potentially create an opening for the return for former LSU coach Brian Kelly, The Athletic's Bruce Feldman reported Friday.

Feldman named Rutgers as a potential landing spot for Kelly, who is looking to make a return to college coaching for the first time since being dismissed by LSU last October.

According to Feldman, Kelly is "very, very motivated to get back on the sidelines."

5 Teams That Can Crash the CFB Playoff 🏈

Feldman pointed out Kelly has connections to the Rutgers front office through president Williams Tate and athletic director Keli Zinn, both of whom worked with Kelly at LSU before heading to New Jersey.

He predicted working at Rutgers "would be a much different dynamic" to LSU and added that "Kelly is very comfortable in the Northeast."

Schiano has drawn scrutiny after leading the Scarlet Knights to an 0-2 start in his seventh season since returning to the program in 2020.

He has three years and $22.5 million remaining on his contract, which would cost about $17.3 million to buy out, per CBS Sports' Robby Kalland .

Kelly spent four years with Cincinnati and 12 with Notre Dame before arriving in Baton Rouge in 2022.

He was dismissed after a 5-3 start to his fourth season with LSU at the cost of a $54 million buyout . CBS Sports announced in July he would serve as an analyst for college football games on the network this season.

Schiano has said he isn't concerned about his employment amid his team's slow start to the season. Whether Rutgers is able to stay competitive Saturday against No. 12 USC could still potentially impact his job security going forward.

articles.title: Carrick brushes off questions over his Manchester United future
articles.summary: Michael Carrick says he expected tough season start as he rebuffs questions about his role as Manchester United manager.
articles.body:
Manchester United boss Michael Carrick said he expected to have to ride out a storm at some point this season after a dreadful start to the current campaign.

Carrick was appointed on a permanent basis after his successful temporary spell at the end of last season secured third place in the Premier League and a return to the Champions League.

But United have taken just four points from their opening four league games this season and were dumped out of the League Cup in a 3-2 defeat by Brighton in midweek after blowing a two-goal lead at Old Trafford for the first time in 50 years.

“In terms of the future and ownership and how long I’ve got, it’s totally nothing. Thinking about it is ridiculous in the position I’m in. It’s ⁠just not on the radar. We’ve got to ⁠perform and we’ve got a lot of games to plan for,” Carrick said ahead of Sunday’s trip to Fulham.

“History tells you that any team that’s successful goes through periods when you have to work through it, come through it and improve.

“We’ve had a small period, in recent time, when it hasn’t been exactly what we want it to be.

“I was expecting a point when we would go through it, it was going to come. We had such a good spell last season, going into this season.”

Former United and England midfielder Carrick also has reason to bemoan his side’s luck in recent weeks.

United received a swift apology from referees’ chiefs after Erling Haaland’s winning goal for Manchester City last weekend was wrongly awarded because the VAR officials did not spot an offside against Enzo Fernandez in the build-up.

Carrick’s men were also heading for three points at Everton last Sunday before until Toffees defender Ainsley Maitland-Niles produced a stunning strike into the top corner from long range.

“It is a week or two, the games haven’t gone our way,” added Carrick. “It’s tiny margins in some of those games. We will work through it. Winning games is always the answer, it can cover up a lot of things at times as well.

“Sometimes it’s the small disappointments that lead to something a bit bigger. It’s part of coping and being at this great football club.”

United could be boosted by the return of Luke Shaw from injury for the visit to Craven Cottage.

Carlos Baleba is also in contention to make his first appearance since a 70 million pound ($94m) move from Brighton.

articles.title: El Eibar inaugura la ‘Joya de la Corona’
articles.standfirst: El club ha abierto las puertas de su nuevo hogar a las instituciones en un acto en el que han estado Pradales, Tebas, Louzán y Beatriz Álvarez
articles.summary: El club ha abierto las puertas de su nuevo hogar a las instituciones en un acto en el que han estado Pradales, Tebas, Louzán y Beatriz Álvarez
articles.body: Areitio. La 'Joya de la Corona'. El lugar donde nacen los sueños. El Eibar ha inaugurado este viernes su Ciudad Deportiva en un acto en el que ha juntado a Imanol Pradales, Javier Tebas, Rafael Louzán y Beatriz Álvarez. Por primera vez en sus 84 años de historia, el club armero dispone de unas instalaciones propias de máximo nivel con un coste que ha superado los 30 millones y que consta de 11 hectáreas, cinco campos de fútbol -dos de hierba natural y tres de hierba artificial- y un edificio exclusivo para el primer equipo del alto rendimiento. El de hoy ha sido un día señalado. La culminación de un proyecto que el Consejo de Administración puso en marcha hace casi una década y que responde a la necesidad histórica de disponer de un espacio común, adaptado a la exigencia actual del fútbol y que permita reunir a toda su estructura deportiva en un mismo lugar. Atrás quedan Atxabalpe, Unbe, Anexo y otros lugares más antiguos como Txantxa Zelai, Lerun o Agorrosin. Gorostiza ha tomado la palabra en un emotivo discurso tras el protocolario corte de cinta y una visita guiada a los invitados. “Hoy no inauguramos un estadio. Ipurua lleva casi ochenta años siendo nuestra casa, y seguirá siéndolo. Pero lo que inauguramos hoy es algo distinto, y en cierto modo más profundo: el lugar donde este club se forma, desde el primer balón que toca un niño o una niña con ocho años, hasta el último entrenamiento antes de un partido de cualquier categoría”. Areitio no es más que la recompensa de los mejores años del Eibar en su historia, pero también es fruto de todos aquellos que trabajaron en otros momentos más complicados. Nadie ha querido perderse el acto y emblemas del club como Artetxe, Bixente, Garmendia, Luluaga, Garitano, Garagarza, Javi Pérez o Mandiola han estado presentes en el acto de bienvenida, donde también se han dejado ver Jokin Aranbarri, César Palacios, Arbilla o Sergio Álvarez. Tebas también ha comparecido para poner en valor el modelo del Eibar a lo largo de su historia. “En una época de endeudamiento absoluto para nuestro fútbol, el Eibar era uno de los pocos, junto al Numancia, que tenía rigor económico. No supo caer en esa trampa para caer categorías. No le hizo falta hacerlo para ascender. Doy las gracias al Eibar porque nos habéis inspirado a que el fútbol español merezca infraestructuras como estas”.

articles.title: Jorge De Frutos, la vuelta más esperada: "Representa el fútbol total"
articles.standfirst: Después de cumplir su sanción de dos encuentros, el segoviano, que se llevó los elogios de Beñat en la previa, podrá jugar ante Osasuna
articles.summary: Después de cumplir su sanción de dos encuentros, el segoviano, que se llevó los elogios de Beñat en la previa, podrá jugar ante Osasuna
articles.body: El pasado 5 de septiembre, el Rayo Vallecano ganó su primer partido de la temporada ante el Racing de Santander. Sin embargo, fue una victoria agridulce. El cuadro franjirrojo ganó 3-2, pero acabó con dos jugadores y un miembro del cuerpo técnico expulsados. Uno de los futbolistas que recibió la cartulina roja fue Jorge De Frutos, por "salir del banquillo gritando y gesticulando de forma reiterada" y protestando una de las decisiones del colegiado "de manera ostensible", según recoge el acta arbitral. El segoviano ya ha cumplido sus dos partidos de sanción (Real Madrid y Espanyol) y ante Osasuna estará de vuelta. La ausencia de Jorge De Frutos fue cubierta por Tsitaishbili que ofreció unos buenos minutos tanto en el Bernabéu como en Butarque, sin embargo, el segoviano es uno de los pilares fundamentales de este equipo y seguramente le ganará la partida en el once. Diferencial en cualquier posición del campo, este jugador lleva siendo el máximo artillero del Rayo desde hace ya dos temporadas (la 25/26 empatado con Álvaro con 12 tantos). Gracias a sus buenas actuaciones, ha podido vestir la camiseta nacional y entrar en la convocatoria de Luis de la Fuente en dos ocasiones. Por si fuera poco, era uno de los candidatos para acudir a la cita mundialista, 'colándose' en esa prelista. Esta temporada, algo extraña en todos los aspectos para el conjunto rayista, no ha comenzado de la mejor manera para Jorge De Frutos en cuanto a las estadísticas goleadoras, pues en los cinco encuentros que ha disputado no ha conseguido ver puerta, pero sí dar una asistencia. Sin embargo, aunque sus números sean escasos de momento, su desempeño dentro del campo va más allá. Sus esfuerzos por la banda derecha, tanto a la hora de sumarse al ataque como para defender, son de vital ayuda para el equipo. Beñat San José fue quien recalcó la importancia de su delantero en la rueda de prensa previa al encuentro frente a Osasuna. "Es un jugador que personalmente me encanta. Representa ese fútbol total. Le veo de nueve también. Puede jugar en las tres posiciones de ataque. Más en la de 'diez' que en la de 'nueve'", afirmó el técnico vasco sobre la polivalencia de su delantero. El conjunto franjirrojo afrontará en Pamplona su último encuentro antes del parón de selecciones. Un Rayo inspirado que viene de obtener la victoria en dos de sus últimos tres encuentros contra Osasuna que viene de encajar cuatro goles ante el Atlético de Madrid.

articles.title: Dundee Utd: Jim Goodwin back in 'good health' despite needing 'simple procedure'
articles.summary: Dundee United manager Jim Goodwin is not for going into detail about his recent hospital scare that requires "a simple procedure" but is "pleased to say I am back to full health and raring to go" after a three-game absence from the dugout.
articles.body:
Dundee United manager Jim Goodwin was not for going into detail about his recent hospital scare that requires "a simple procedure".

But he was "pleased to say I am back to full health and raring to go" after a three-game absence from the dugout.

The 44-year-old will be back on the sidelines as United visit his former club St Mirren on Saturday.

Back on media duty on Friday, Goodwin said: "It was something pretty straightforward in the end. It was a simple procedure required and once that is done and all tidied up then it will be nothing that I need to worry about going forward.

"It was a huge surprise to me and my wife and to my children. I am not one that gets coughs or colds, I am not one that misses days at work and I am not a great patient because it is not something I have ever been used to."

Goodwin on health scare, delight at return & St Mirren test

Goodwin to resume Dundee Utd duties after three-week absence

Nevertheless, Goodwin has been "absolutely overwhelmed" by the messages of support since he was admitted to hospital at the end of August.

"What I would like to say is a huge thank you to all the people out there from the football world and far beyond who have reached out and passed on their best wishes," he added.

"From the club here at Dundee United to our supporters, they put a nice display on last week against Falkirk – obviously my wife and my children and the NHS staff at the Royal Hospital in Glasgow and at Stobhill in Bishopbriggs, they have all been brilliant, but I am pleased to say I am back to full health and raring to go."

In his absence, assistant Lee Sharp took the team, presiding over a 4-0 win away to Kilmarnock - a defeat at Motherwell and a home draw with Falkirk.

Goodwin was asked how frustrating he has found not being able to be hands-on over the last three weeks.

"It was a strange period for my children as well because in 20 years they have never been used to me being at home, so it took a little bit of getting used to, but I have to say the staff here at Dundee United and the players have been brilliant," he added.

"I have had constant dialogue with them on a daily basis. I have still been able to watch the games and communicate with the bench and things like that, but tomorrow it will be brilliant to be back on the sidelines and back at a familiar spot as well in Paisley playing against St Mirren."

articles.title: La ampliación de la financiación del Espai Barça, a votación
articles.standfirst: El club catalán celebra este sábado la Asamblea
articles.summary: El club catalán celebra este sábado la Asamblea
articles.body: El Barcelona se mide mañana por la noche al Sevilla en el Sánchez Pizjuán, pero la actividad del club comenzará a primera hora. Durante el día, la entidad azulgrana celebrará su Asamblea General Ordinaria, una cita especialmente relevante por los asuntos económicos y financieros que figuran en el orden del día. La cumbre volverá a ser de carácter telemático, por séptimo año consecutivo, y están citados 4.597 compromisarios. Entre los puntos más importantes de la jornada está, la aprobación del ejercicio económico de la 25-26 y la votación para ampliar la financiación para llevar a cabo el proyecto del Espai Barça, que incluye las obras del Spotify Camp Nou. La Asamblea General arrancará a las 9.30 horas, en primera convocatoria y, a las 10:00, en segunda. El punto inicial será el discurso de Joan Laporta y después, la junta azulgrana procederá a explicar las cuentas de la temporada 25-26. Entre los números más destacados, el Barcelona mostrará unos ingresos de 1.065 millones de euros y unos gastos de explotación de 1.022. Además, anunciará el presupuesto para esta campaña, la 26-27, que es continuista y conservador, y la previsión de la entidad es de 1.195 kilos de ingresos y 1.133 de gastos. El cuarto punto en el orden del día será, precisamente, la aprobación de la ampliación de la financiación obtenida para llevar a cabo el proyecto Espai Barça. La cantidad solicitada será de 300 millones de euros, además de un bonus de 210, para concluir las obras de remodelación del Spotify Camp Nou. El coste total asciende a alrededor de 1.800 kilos. Durante la Asamblea también se pondrá a votación la ratificación de contratos con Ohana Real State development and construction LLC y Babylon Park Spain SL, y se ratificará los nombramientos de miembros de la Junta Directiva y de la comisión económica. Además, se presentará un informe del Síndic de los socios y, para terminar, la junta escuchará las propuestas de los compromisarios.

articles.title: Torres: "Veo siempre al Atlético y luego al Barça porque es espectacular"
articles.standfirst: El Niño analiza el derbi y su faceta de entrenador en una entrevista exclusiva con MARCA
articles.summary: El Niño
articles.body: Fernando Torres dice que los sueños dejan de ser sueños cuando te pones a ello, a lo que buscas con constancia, el secreto del éxito. Ahora su sueño está en el banquillo, en forjarse como un líder para llegar lejos en el oficio, marcando su propio estilo, recogiendo lo mejor de cada maestro que pasó por su carrera y andar un camino firme que ya se aprecia con el Atlético Madrileño. Pero hay sueños también más efímeros pero intensos, como un derbi. El Niño acudirá este domingo, como siempre que puede, al Metropolitano, evitando la mirada de entrenador, aunque cueste. "Intento ponerme la bufanda de aficionado y disfrutar con el Atleti". MARCA se ha sentado con Fernando aprovechando su regreso a la tienda de Nike en Las Rozas que ahora cumple 30 años, los mismos que la marca deportiva lleva en España. Entre esos pasillos entró hace ya muchos años un niño con la ilusión de llegar lejos. El campeón del mundo recorre ese camino de nuevo, lo más parecido son las espinilleras con las que debutó ante el Leganés en el Calderón y que trae bajo el brazo: analiza su faceta de entrenador, al Atlético, al Madrid y a un Barça "espectacular" tras una mirada al derbi de este domingo. PREGUNTA: Para empezar por lo que más le toca, ¿qué expectativas tiene esta temporada? RESPUESTA: Como siempre, construir un equipo y desde lo colectivo poder hacer que los jugadores individualmente se acerquen a lo que buscan. Tanto los que vienen de años en la academia como todos los jugadores que este año han venido y que han apostado por estar aquí. Con ese cóctel estamos seguros de que podemos construir un equipo, no sabemos cuánto nos va a costar, pero de momento los chicos, con la actitud que están teniendo, puede ser espectacular. P. Para un entrenador con gen ganador pero en su situación, ¿piensa más en ascender o en formar a los jugadores? R. Los objetivos para nosotros son varios. Lo primero es entender que estamos en un filial y que el objetivo es formar futbolistas para nuestro primer equipo y si no puede ser para nuestro primer equipo, que tengan posibilidades de ir al fútbol profesional. Y creo que desde el año pasado, con esta manera de trabajar, lo hemos conseguido. Para nosotros ha sido un gran éxito tener tres jugadores en el primer equipo este año, tener cuatro jugadores que han ido a la Primera División, dos a Segunda, y Rafa Llorente a la liga MX, todos fútbol profesional. Creo que los jugadores han dado un paso adelante muy grande. Y los que vienen lo han visto y ven que esto puede ser una plataforma si nos siguen y si hacen las cosas como nosotros pensamos que se tienen que hacer en el Atlético de Madrid, que no es otra cosa que a través de la exigencia, del respeto, del ser un buen compañero, un buen profesional y, lo más importante, de querer estar aquí. Yo solo pienso en lo mejor para el Atlético. P. ¿Cuándo pensaste que este oficio era el suyo? Y no sé si ahora le va enganchando más a medida que pasa el tiempo... R. Al principio fue un poco por casualidad empezar el curso de entrenador porque era la promoción que podía coger, si no tenía que esperar cuatro años, me acababa de retirar. Llegó el COVID y, no sé cómo, aquí estoy. Entré en esa generación, tuve que seguir haciendo los cursos mientras entrenaba porque se juntaron una serie de cosas y, bueno, me han liado. Cuando me di cuenta que me gustaba esto fue cuando empezamos en el curso a hacer las prácticas en el campo, donde veían las cosas, vi que podía aprender mucho, que podía aportar. Y cuando hice las prácticas con el cadete A del Atlético de Madrid, ya con futbolistas, y vi cómo los jugadores me miraban, cómo me escuchaban, cómo me podía acercar a ellos, desde ese lugar de asistente encontré una manera de entender que el futbol va de personas. Ya lo sabía, pero desde la parte de entrenador entendí que la conexión y la relación personal con los jugadores para mí es esencial. No puedes exigir al futbolista si no conoces a la persona. R. Dicen que lo peor es que los jugadores piensen que su entrenador es un pesado, ¿la clave cómo dice es saber hacer llegar el mensaje a los jugadores porque todo está ya inventado? P. Por supuesto. Que esté todo inventado es cierto, pero todo vuelve también. Lo que no servía hace dos años, el año que viene va a servir. Y ahí está la manera de entender el futbol de cada uno, que todas son válidas. Pero yo ya les aviso a mis jugadores que soy muy pesados al principio, así luego no les pillo por sorpresa. Pero si tienes esa conexión, los jugadores te siguen. Luego está la parte de dirección deportiva: qué jugadores vienen, con qué jugadores cuentas, cuál es el potencial del futbolista, pero si no tienes conexión y no creen en lo que hacen, no sirve. En mi propia experiencia, cuando he sido jugador, cuando he sido capaz de conectar con la idea del entrenador y el equipo ha ido todo a esas ideas, casi siempre las cosas han ido muy bien. P. ¿Y en qué estilo y en carácter encajamos a Fernando? R. A mí me gustaría que mis equipos se parezcan a lo que a mí me gustaría ver cuando estoy delante de la televisión. Me gustan los equipos atrevidos, dinámicos, verticales, de ida y vuelta, que aceptan este juego moderno de transición, que son capaces de atacar pero también de defender, pero que pasan cosas en el partido. Creo que es también una manera muy buena de conectar con la otra parte fundamental del fútbol que es el aficionado. Cuando el aficionado está viendo un partido y se levanta de la silla y se vuelve a levantar y están pasando cosas continuamente, se engancha, y más el Atlético. P. ¿Qué manual de entrenador tienes en la mesilla de noche? R. Tengo la suerte de haber estado con grandes entrenadores, incluso por desgracia antes de querer ser entrenador. Habría aprendido y apuntado muchísimas cosas, pero he estado con Luis, que me marcó mucho, luego en la selección con Vicente, todos los entrenadores que he tenido en el Atleti... Luego llegué a Inglaterra con Rafa Benitez, que es un entrenador que me ha marcado mucho, Ancelotti, después Mourinho, Simeone... He tenido grandes entrenadores, pero nunca en esa época yo pensé ser entrenador. Creo que he cogido un poquito de todos, he aprendido de todos, pero una vez que me enfoqué en querer ser entrenador, el que yo he visto y me ha marcado ha sido Jurgen Klopp. P. ¿Y con qué mirada, cuando vas al Metropolitano, ves al Atleti? ¿Con la mirada de aficionado o la de entrenador? R. Cuando voy al Metropolitano intento ponerme la bufanda de aficionado y disfrutar con el Atleti. Intento no analizar demasiado, ir a ver a mi equipo, a animar, a estar con los míos, a sentirlo, intento aparcar el entrenador por un ratito. Es inevitable, pero lo intento. P. ¿Y cómo es la comunicación con el Cholo, inevitable por otro lado como los jefes de los dos equipos? R. Diaria, porque tenemos jugadores que están en dinámica con ellos, aunque pueden jugar con nosotros. Información sobre los jugadores que van haciéndolo muy bien para que puedan tenerlos en cuenta. También con el C y con el Juvenil porque la conexión de la Youth League nos afecta tanto al primer equipo como a nosotros. Entonces, la comunicación entre los responsables de cada equipo es diaria. Intentamos siempre dar la información para el objetivo principal, que obviamente es el primer equipo. P. ¿Qué destacaría de este nuevo Atlético? R. Al principio de temporada tenemos mucha ilusión todos los atléticos. Vemos que es un gran equipo, que hay grandes jugadores, que se mantiene una base grande, que los jugadores que han llegado son muy importantes. Estamos deseando que lleguen los partidos, ver cómo el equipo va mejorando y va creciendo. Este domingo hay un gran partido, todos tenemos mucha ilusión. Ojalá se den las cosas como esperamos P. Sufriste en su etapa más en los derbis que ahora, ¿podemos decir que el Atlético se ha ganado ser favorito el domingo? R. A mí nunca me ha gustado poner etiquetas ¿Quién es el favorito? Creo que el Atleti hoy en día lo que tiene es ilusión por ir a ese partido y seguridad en que lo puede ganar. Es un gran cambio respecto a esa época. R. Con respecto al año pasado, ¿ve un cambio sustancial en el Atlético? R. Entiendo que han sido muchos fichajes, salidas importantes y que están en ese proceso de crecimiento que yo creo que se está viendo. Hoy es difícil ver un once, por ejemplo. Son muy positivos, un equipo grande. P. Y en lo que respecta al Madrid de Mourinho, ¿ve a un Mou más humano? R. Yo no estoy en el día a día en ese equipo. Yo he conocido a un Mourinho que era un líder tremendo en el vestuario. Esa capacidad de liderazgo es lo que más puedo destacar de él. Y ahora no estoy dentro y eso no se ve. Vemos a un entrenador más maduro, seguro que sabe gestionar grupos y eso creo que es algo muy importante para un vestuario. P. ¿Viste al Madrid? ¿Cómo lo ves? R. No lo he visto demasiado. Pregúntame por el Huesca (próximo rival del Atlético Madrileño). La verdad es que he visto poco fútbol este año, pero sí he visto mucho al Barça porque es un espectáculo, obviamente todos los partidos del Atleti y lo poco que he visto del Madrid está claro que son grandes jugadores y cuando parece que el partido está perdido, lo ganan. Como siempre. P. ¿El Barça debe ser el favorito entonces? R. Estamos empezando. La temporada es muy larga, hay lesiones, se pueden dar mil situaciones. Hoy creo que es uno de los equipos más en forma de Europa, sin ninguna duda, pero queda muchísimo. P. La final del Champions se va a jugar el Metropolitano, ¿eso es bueno o malo? R. Yo creo que cada vez más, y espero que sea así, el Atlético no tiene miedo de hablar las cosas. Cuando llegan esas preguntas parece que la gente tiene miedo a contestarlas porque ya estamos creando una situación incómoda, nosotros tenemos que ir como aficionados a los partidos con la ilusión de que el equipo gane. Pero no vamos a pensar en algo que va a pasar en mayo porque queda muchísimo. Cuando llegue el siguiente partido de Champions se afrontará, igual que se afrontará el domingo. P. ¿Qué te marcó tanto de Klopp? R. Tuve la suerte de verle trabajar una semana, que me invitó a Liverpool en su última temporada y lo que ves en sus equipos... Ese vértigo, esa verticalidad, la manera de presionar, la intensidad, cómo la gente conecta con esa idea, sobre todo en Inglaterra que tiene ese fútbol de ida y vuelta que tanto me gusta. Su liderazgo en el vestuario, tuve la suerte de estar en las charlas, de estar en el hotel, de estar cuando dio la alineación y ver ese respeto mutuo entre entrenador y jugador, cómo aceptan una idea y piensan que es la mejor. Obviamente no estuve mucho tiempo, pero me hizo ver que el reflejo que tú quieres que tenga tu equipo es a base de entrenar. Lo vi en el entrenamiento y después lo vi en el partido y su personalidad es tremenda. P. Se habla mucho del Balón de Oro, ¿a quién se lo daría? R. No me interesa mucho ese tema, la verdad. España ha sido campeona del mundo, ¿no? Hemos sido los mejores, premios individuales ya se dieron en el Mundial, no sé ni siquiera cuáles son los criterios hoy en día porque van cambiando. Pero tenemos a Lamine, tenemos a Fabián, tenemos a Rodri, tenemos a Pedri, a Baena. ¿Cuántos más? Se lo merecen. P. ¿Le sorprendió ganar el Mundial? Al menos con tanta superioridad a veces como ante Francia. R. Para nada. Veía un equipo hecho, un equipo muy seguro de lo que hacía, veía un equipo que tenía hambre, que tenía seguridad desde el principio hasta el final. Fue maravilloso verlo. P. Para terminar, ¿le ha sorprendido Luis Enrique? R. No. Me encantan dos cosas de él. Primero, su personalidad, que no varía su en función del equipo que tiene o del momento que atraviesa, y eso denota seguridad en lo que hace. Y que es un entrenador que anticipa lo que va a pasar. Un poco, creo, como Guardiola. Son los dos entrenadores que buscan soluciones antes de que el problema aparezca. Siempre le crean un problema a los equipos. Incluso de temporada a temporada, cuando parece que tienes tiempo para analizar sus equipos y más o menos sabes por dónde les tienes que tapar, ya han hecho un cambio. Y eso cuesta tiempo. Siempre los inicios son complicados, pero su equipo siempre va de menos a más. Luis Aragonés: Un padre. Del Bosque. Gestión. Ancelotti: Inteligencia. Mourinho: Líder. Benítez: Meticuloso. Simeone: Pasión. Guardiola: Genio. Luis Enrique: Otro genio. Es que me encanta Luis Enrique, no sabría decirte una... Ya he dicho las importantes... Inspirador. Flick: Magnífico. De la Fuente: Un ejemplo.

articles.title: Zidane recupera a Camavinga y deja fuera a Tchouameni en su primera lista con Francia
articles.standfirst: Once jugadores que disputaron el pasado Mundial se han quedado fuera de lista del ex técnico del Madrid
articles.summary: Once jugadores que disputaron el pasado Mundial se han quedado fuera de lista del ex técnico del Madrid
articles.body: Zinedine Zidane ya ejerce como nuevo seleccionador de Francia. El técnico francés debutará el próximo 25 de octubre ante Turquía en el estadio Yildiz Entegre Kocaeli Stadyumu de Kocaeli y ha dado algunas sorpresas en su primera convocatoria. Una de las grandes novedades ha sido, sin duda, el regreso de Eduardo Camavinga. El mediocentro se quedó fuera de la lista de convocados del pasado Mundial a última hora y, aunque no haya gozado de muchos minutos con el Real Madrid en el inicio de temporada, Zidane considera que puede aportar mucho en su medular. También ha habido ausencias en la primera convocatoria de Zizou. Hasta 11 con respecto a la lista del Mundial. En el sector izquierdo, por ejemplo, ninguno de los hermanos Hernández ha sido llamado a filas por el seleccionador francés. Tchouaméni, a diferencia de Camavinga, finalmente se queda en Madrid recuperándose de las molestias que le han impedido competir al comienzo de la temporada. Kanté, Digne o Marcus Thuram son otros de los jugadores que no han contado con la confianza de Zidane en su primera lista. En el capítulo de novedades destaca la presencia del central del Liverpool, Jeremy Jacquet, del delantero del Rennes, Esteban Lepaul o Andy Diouf, Da Cunha, centrocampista del Como. Para la rotación en la portería, Zidane ha decidido contar con el meta del Toulouse, Guillaume Restes Zidane debutará como seleccionador francés el 25 de septiembre ante la Turquía de Vincenzo Montella en la Liga de Naciones. Tras un segundo compromiso a domicilio contra la Bélgica de Mark van Bommel, el 28 de septiembre, Zizou dirigirá su primer partido como local al frente de Les Bleus el 22 de octubre ante la renovada Italia de Mancini. Porteros: Maignan, Restes, Robin Risser Defensas: Andy Diouf, Jeremy Jacquet, Pierre Kalulu, Ibrahima Konaté , Jules Koundé, Maxence Lacroix, Adrien Truffert , Dayot Upamecano. Centrocampistas: Camavinga, Rayan Cherki, Lucas Da Cunha, Manu Koné, Adrien Rabiot, Warren Zaire-Emery. Delanteros: Bradley Barcola, Ousmane Dembélé, Desiré Doué, Esteban Lepaul, Kylian Mbappé, Michael Olise.

articles.title: Celtic vs Rangers: Old Firm talking points ahead first Premiership clash of season, live on Sky Sports on Sunday
articles.summary: Celtic lost to Rangers in the League Cup before a Europa League defeat to Ferencvaros; the Ibrox side could make it six straight wins after a tough start under Derek McInnes; watch the first Old Firm league game of the season this Sunday, live on Sky Sports
articles.body:
The Old Firm sides meet in the Scottish Premiership on Sunday, live on Sky Sports, seven days after the Ibrox side laid down a marker with an emphatic League Cup win.

While McInnes appears to have weathered an early storm at Rangers, O'Neill is looking for solutions after Celtic followed up that 3-0 defeat with a 3-1 loss to Ferencvaros in the Europa League.

We look at some of the talking points ahead of what is sure to be another fascinating encounter...

It is amazing how quickly things can change in football.

Just a few months ago, O'Neill was at peak legendary Celtic status after saving their season to deliver a league and cup double.

They then capitulated against LASK and crashed out of the Champions League, but a winning domestic start kept the pressure off.

However, the League Cup defeat to Rangers, followed by their Europa League loss to Ferencvaros means Sunday could be seen as a must-win for the veteran boss - even if the 74-year-old does not think so.

Celtic are guaranteed to go into the international break top of the Scottish Premiership, but few Celtic fans would accept back-to-back defeats to their fiercest rivals. Especially when they have dominated domestically for so long.

O'Neill will be desperately seeking solutions ahead of Sunday's game after admitting their confidence has taken a hit.

While the pressure is mounting at Parkhead, it appears to be easing at Ibrox after a turbulent start for McInnes.

Failure to secure European football and a slow start domestically had many wondering if he was the right manager to deliver silverware.

But then the results started to come, and a tactical masterclass against Celtic to reach the League Cup semi-finals has switched the momentum.

The former Rangers midfielder backed himself to bring success to the club and victory on Sunday would put them just two points behind Celtic in the Scottish Premiership.

But defeat would leave them eight points in arrears after just seven games. If that happens, the scrutiny would no doubt return.

It is not just a selection headache, but a dizzying migraine facing O'Neill - with five key positions to ponder before Sunday's showdown.

You can only confidently predict six of his starting XI: captain Callum McGregor, talismanic midfielder Benjamin Nygren, top scorer Camilo Duran, fans' favourite Kieran Tierney, reliable defender Cameron Carter-Vickers and academy graduate Colby Donovan.

GK: Goalkeeper Sam Johnstone was less than convincing on his Old Firm debut last weekend and was replaced by previous No 1 Viljami Sinisalo against Ferencvaros on Thursday.

LCB: Liam Scales and Auston Trusty regularly trade places at left centre-back, but the former has started the last two matches in that position.

CM: Captain McGregor was left exposed as a solo sitting midfield player at Ibrox so O'Neill might be tempted to bring in Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain for Mika Baur to provide additional protection. He must weigh-up whether he sticks with one six and two eights or switches to two sixes and one 10.

RW : Haissem Hassan has impressed since signing from Real Oviedo this summer but was left out of the starting XI last Sunday. The Egyptian must surely be in contention - especially if Rangers are expected to defend three-vs-three at the back.

ST: Club-record signing Kasper Hogh has scored in just one of his seven matches for Celtic so far. He was left on the bench against Ferencvaros to allow Duran to operate in his more natural No 9 position and may find it difficult to dislodge the Colombian from there. If that were to be the case, it is a toss-up between James Forrest and Sebastian Tounekti for the left-wing berth.

Will Rangers stick or twist at Parkhead?

McInnes got his game plan spot on at Ibrox, and Celtic could not live with his team.

He used left-back James Penrice as an auxiliary midfielder to flood the middle of the pitch - allowing Rangers to press Celtic man for man.

Djeidi Gassama and Min-Su Kim provided width and energy as wing-backs with Dujon Sterling, Emmanuel Fernandez and Olwethu Makhanya defending three-vs-three against Celtic's front line.

It was a bold decision that paid dividends as Celtic folded under the pressure.

Dan Neil snatched the starring role of midfield general from his Celtic counterpart McGregor, who was left isolated without a defensive-minded midfield partner.

The former Sunderland man would probably have still been named player of the match even if he had not netted two famous derby goals.

But Celtic Park will be a different test, especially with no away fans.

McInnes opted for two strikers last Sunday, but he might plump for an extra body in the heart of midfield.

If he does switch, will it be Ryan Naderi or Kevin Kelsy in that No 9 role?

Kelsy scored his first Rangers goal last weekend and was a constant threat, Naderi provided the assist but is a doubt for Sunday's showdown with an ankle problem.

He also has the option of Bojan Miovski, a player who knows the intensity of playing at Celtic Park from his days with Aberdeen.

If McInnes gets it right, he will be the first manager since Walter Smith in 1991 to win his first two Old Firm games in charge.

"We're still in the lead and if we could win this, we can extend the lead and if we don't, even by the international break, we're still going to be in front.

"We're going to try and put that right if we can. But I know the last time we had an international break was in March time and we played very poorly against Dundee United.

"So that was, if you can call it a wake-up call or a moment of quiet reflection or whatever the case may be. We turned it round. The players are capable of turning it round.

"It's a big game, whether it's played in September or March time.

"We need to be up for the game. Do we need to win the game? It would be nice to win it, it wouldn't be great if we lost.

"That would be three on the trot. Psychologically, it would be a blow. But we need to be up for it."

"Just because you win the game doesn't mean it always says you've got the tactics right and, equally, when you lose a game, it doesn't mean it says you've got them wrong.

"I think sometimes tactics can get a wee bit overplayed. I do think you normally win games during the individual moments and the performance of players being really high and really strong.

"We look to do something similar in terms of our approach. We want to make sure the aggression's there, the confidence is there to play.

"The energy that we displayed last week, these are all the things that are more important than tactics.

"Hopefully the players go into the game and onto the pitch with that message loud and clear that a big performance is required.

"You don't win at Celtic Park unless everybody plays well. We've got to try and bring something similar and look for those improvements again.

"Once the ball rolls, it's a game of football that we need to concentrate on the detail, in and out of possession, what we're looking to try and do."

articles.title: Republic of Ireland v Israel: FAI says Uefa rejected request to keep teams separate in future draws
articles.summary: The Football Association of Ireland says it had a request to keep the Republic of Ireland and Israel separate in future competition draws rejected by Uefa.
articles.body:
Football Association of Ireland chief executive David Courell says it had a request to keep the Republic of Ireland and Israel separate in future competition draws rejected by Uefa.

After being grouped together in February's draw, the Republic of Ireland and Israel are set to meet in Nations League fixtures on 27 September and 4 October.

In June, the FAI confirmed its home game on 4 October would be played behind closed doors in Backa Topola, Serbia, as opposed to Dublin's Aviva Stadium, while no tickets will be made available for Irish fans for Israel's 'home' fixture in Debrecen, Hungary.

At an extraordinary general meeting in July, delegates backed an FAI motion to proceed with the games amid concerns that boycotting would cause "significant and lasting harm" for the association.

However, the decision to fulfil the fixtures has come under increasing pressure amid the ongoing conflict in the Middle East , with a 'Stop The Game' campaign launched by Irish Sport for Palestine calling for a boycott.

Speaking to reporters on Friday, Courell said European football's governing body Uefa rejected the association's request about future draws, which was made after the teams were drawn together in February.

"The response was pretty clear. They [Uefa] have a formal term for it, I can't remember the formal term, the 'do not draw' list or whatever. It's based, really, on conflicts, direct conflicts, not public sentiment," said , external Courell.

"The answer I got was very clear. That would not be possible, because Ireland and Israel have never been in direct conflict. That was an answer that I took at face value."

BBC Sport NI has contacted Uefa for comment.

Hallgrimsson spoke to players individually about Israel games

Israel fixtures an 'uncomfortable situation' for FAI

Boycott of Israel games would cause 'significant and lasting harm' - FAI

The 'Stop the Game' campaign has received support from former Republic of Ireland manager Brian Kerr and ex-player James McClean , and May's friendly against Qatar in Dublin was disrupted when tennis balls were thrown on to the pitch .

Speaking to RTE, Courell said he "appreciated" the "strength of sentiment" among the Irish public regarding the games and pointing out that the FAI previously called on Uefa to ban Israel from European competition.

"We wish we weren't in this position. We have publicly called for, and formally called for, Israel's removal from international football," he said.

"We were the only federation in Uefa, so one out of 55 that has done so formally. But at an institutional level, that hasn't happened yet.

"As such, the decision rested with the FAI and we wanted particularly now to offer our spport and protection to the players because it's a decision that rested with the FAI board."

He added: "We have spoken to Uefa extensively over the last year, yes. And their response? It's the same as it has been for some time. They recognise the strength of conviction from the FAI on this topic and how that reflects the solidarity the Irish people have of the Palestinian plight.

"But equally they have to consider the sentiment of 54 other nations. And unfortunately, at this moment in time, it's not universal."

The armed Palestinian group Hamas attacked Israel on 7 October 2023, killing about 1,200 people and taking 251 hostages. In response, Israel launched a massive military offensive in Gaza. The United Nations believes the retaliation has killed more than 70,000 Palestinians.

Israel has regularly denied committing genocide or war crimes and has said its actions in Gaza have been justified as a means of self-defence.

articles.title: Zidane: "¿Mbappé defender? Es un problema sin fundamento, un debate sin importancia"
articles.standfirst: El seleccionador confirma que Mbappé será su capitán
articles.summary: El seleccionador confirma que Mbappé será su capitán
articles.body: Zinedine Zidane ha dado a conocer su primera convocatoria con Francia en la que se han dado diferentes novedades y varias sorpresas. El seleccionador francés ha desgranado algunas de sus decisiones, "entre lesiones, minutos de juego… es la primera selección, la primera concentración, las ideas estaban bastante claras. Puede que haya uno o dos jugadores que no estén intencionadamente, por falta de minutos de juego o lesiones leves". Mbappé continuará como capitán: “Es mi jugador y será capitán. ¿Defender poco? “Es un problema sin fundamento, un debate sin importancia; habrá que afrontarlo como con los demás jugadores. Cuando no tengamos la posesión, tendremos que esforzarnos, y Kylian lo hará como todos los demás”. Mbappé y el Balón de Oro: “Sé lo que significa ganar el Balón de Oro. De vez en cuando hay pequeñas conversaciones, pero no necesariamente vamos a hablar de eso internamente.” Primera convocatoria: “Hay mucho que pensar, porque tienes jugadores que acaban de regresar del Mundial. Entre lesiones, minutos de juego… Es la primera convocatoria y la primera concentración… teníamos cosas claras. Puede que haya uno o dos jugadores que no estén por falta de minutos de juego o lesiones leves, pero ha sido mucho trabajo desde mi nombramiento el 28 de julio". Ausencia de Tchouameni: “Ha estado de baja durante dos meses. Para su recuperación, era mejor que se quedara en Madrid.” Regreso de Benzema: “Le conozco bien de la etapa en Madrid y me encanta hablar de él porque es admirable. Aunque estamos buscando perfiles más jóvenes, al igual que con Kanté, vuelvo a decir lo mismo. Pretendemos rejuvenecer la plantilla. Eso no resta su trayectoria con la selección francesa ni a nivel de clubes”. Opciones para la portería: “Hemos meditado mucho la decisión y todos empiezan de cero. Trabajaremos con estos tres porteros. Fabien (Barthez) y yo compartimos la misma visión. Él me ayudará a elegir”

articles.title: UEFA, CONCACAF challenge FIFA on reserves and demand $10m payout to members
articles.summary: Confederation chiefs call on Gianni Infantino to make $2.1bn payout to all FIFA’s 211 member associations.
articles.body:
UEFA President Aleksander Ceferin and CONCACAF President Victor Montagliani have called for an independent review of FIFA’s financial reserves and proposed a $2.1bn payout to its 211 member associations, ⁠in a further sign of growing tensions over the abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise project.

The proposal would make at least $10m available to each member association over the 2027-30 cycle and would come on top of funding already committed under the world football body’s Forward Programme, the ⁠two FIFA vice-presidents said in a letter addressed on Friday to FIFA President Gianni Infantino and seen by the Reuters news agency.

The FIFA Forward Enterprise, or FFE, had been presented to the 211 member associations as a plan under which an interest in FIFA’s competitions would be sold to outside investors in order to generate significantly more money for football development.

FFE was abandoned after a backlash, but Infantino is still expected to seek another term and his ‌opponents are struggling to find a challenger for the March 2027 vote.

Ceferin and Montagliani said their analysis of FIFA’s published financial statements and budgets raised questions about whether such a transaction had been necessary.

“Our analysis now raises an important question as to whether the proposed transaction was necessary to deliver greater resources to the MAs,” the letter said.

They said FIFA was on course to end the 2023-26 cycle with reserves of about $6bn, which they described as the largest in its history, and argued that the governing body already had the capacity to distribute substantially more money to its national associations from its own balance sheet.

Under their proposal, at least $10m would be made available to each member association during the 2027-30 cycle for investment in infrastructure ⁠and football development, for an aggregate of about $2.1bn.

The one-off release would be additional to the existing FIFA Forward Programme, which would continue in full.

Ceferin and Montagliani said that even after such a distribution, FIFA’s reserves would not fall below about $1.5bn at any point during the next cycle, about 50 percent above what they said was ⁠the minimum reserve level FIFA itself had budgeted for 2023-26.

They acknowledged that their analysis was preliminary, combining published actual results for 2022-25 with estimates for 2026 and assumptions for the 2027-30 cycle.

They, therefore, ⁠called for an independent review with full access to the underlying figures and assumptions ⁠before recommendations are submitted through FIFA’s governance process.

Once a clearer picture of FIFA’s year-end financial position is available, the letter said, the FIFA Council could determine whether a larger distribution was possible and whether an equivalent payout should follow in the 2031-34 cycle.

The letter also cast the issue as one of governance, saying member associations should not have ‌to choose between development funding and the ability to assess FIFA proposals independently.

“Development is an institutional responsibility of FIFA – not a matter of individual discretion,” it said.

Ceferin and Montagliani proposed that the confederations jointly complete the analysis and agree on the amount of reserves that should ‌be ‌released directly to member associations, with recommendations submitted for consideration at the next FIFA Council meeting.

They said they would also ask the presidents of the other four continental confederations to support the proposal.

FIFA did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

articles.title: JJ Gabriel edging closer to Manchester United exit amid Barcelona talks about a potential move for the forward
articles.summary: JJ Gabriel, 15, has made it clear he wants to leave Man Utd and has asked to be de-registered to become a free agent; Real, Barcelona, PSG and Bayern, along with several Premier League clubs, are interested in the forward; Gabriel and his representatives are in Barcelona for talks
articles.body:
The 15-year-old is attracting interest from a number of Premier League clubs, as well as Real Madrid, Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain and Bayern Munich, after he and his team put in a formal request to leave United.

Despite the leadership at United being hopeful they can persuade the young star to stay at the club as he is contracted until the end of the season, it looks more and more likely Gabriel is edging closer to a move away from Old Trafford.

Gabriel and his representatives put in a formal request to be de-registered after the UEFA Youth League tie against Sabah last Thursday - a game United won 5-0 with Gabriel scoring a hat-trick.

Gabriel, who was not named in any of England's youth squads announced on Friday despite representing England most recently at U17 level, has not trained with United since then.

There is a belief - owing to a precedent due to a FIFA loophole - that Gabriel could leave United for a club in Europe once he turns 16 [on October 6] if he obtains a European passport that he could get through either of his parents.

However, any move for Gabriel would be subject to FIFA approval.

United head coach Michael Carrick was asked about Gabriel on Friday and reiterated his view that the matter needed to be handled carefully.

"I think he's a young boy, JJ, and I think it's important that we certainly don't play anything out here," he said.

"I think the exposure and the scrutiny and everything, you've got to be careful and be sensible and think of him as much as anything, so the situation will work itself out, whatever way it's going to work itself out. Making sure he's okay is the important thing."

"First of all, he's an unbelievable talent. The problem now is with the lad and probably his agents and his family - I don't know him so I'm only thinking from the outside.

"When you're watching Max Dowman at Arsenal and Rio Ngumoha getting given a chance at Liverpool and doing very well, he's probably thinking, 'I should be playing at Man Utd now as well'.

"This is the problem you're going to have with the kids of this day and age. They're so talented that they want to play straight away. When I was playing, it was unheard of at 16.

"It'll be a massive blow for Man Utd. Believe me, this kid is an unbelievable talent. They'll have every club in the world wanting him."

articles.title: Top Big 12 football games to watch for Week 3 of 2026 season
articles.summary: Houston-Texas Tech headlines the Big 12's Week 3 slate, while Arizona State-Kansas and Colorado-Northwestern highlight other games to watch.
articles.body:
After an interesting Week 2 in the Big 12 that included the biggest upset of the week when Oklahoma State took down Oregon, there is another good week of college football headlined by Houston facing Texas Tech in the Friday night slot on Fox.

Best Game of the Week: No. 22 Houston vs. No. 13 Texas Tech

This one is easy to figure out. No. 23 Houston faces No. 12 Texas Tech in an intrastate rivalry with huge implications for the Big 12. It is the first conference matchup between two ranked teams and will be the first true test for the Red Raiders if they should be the favorites in the conference. Houston has been viewed as a dark horse candidate to win the Big 12 in the offseason. But if they pull off this win against Texas Tech, they could actually be in the driver's seat to get into the conference championship game.

Potential upset: Arizona State vs. Kansas

It wouldn't be much of an upset if the Sun Devils lost to the Jayhawks. Both teams enter the game 1-1, having won their season opener and lost their second game. But it is still a game to watch, since it's the first college football game in London since 1988. Based on some NFL games in London, weird things can happen when you travel to another country for a football game. Look at TCU and North Carolina a few weeks ago in Ireland. ASU arrived in London a few days before Kansas, and the Sun Devils seem to have a more explosive offense, so I expect them to win. But an upset is certainly possible.

Most Big 12 teams are playing non-Power Four teams in Week 3. However, the only Big 12 matchups against another Power conference are Colorado at Northwestern. The Buffaloes are slight underdogs going against the Wildcats. However, with their electric offense, strong run game, and much-improved run defense, Colorado can certainly win.

West Virginia is also facing off against No. 25 Virginia in the Duke's Mayo Classic. The Hokies come into that game as double-digit favorites and for good reason. Both teams enter the game 2-0, but Virginia has a dominant win over NC State, while West Virginia's best win is a Week 2 victory over UT Martin. The Mountaineers barely survived Coastal Carolina in their season opener. I don't expect an upset here, but hopefully West Virginia can at least keep things interesting.

In other conference action, Kansas State takes on Tulane, while Iowa State looks to bounce back from their first loss of the season to Iowa with a win over Bowling Green. No. 17 Utah is a 28-point favorite over Utah State, while Cincinnati is also heavily favored in their game against Miami Ohio.

Baylor is looking to build off their first win of the season with a victory against LA Tech on Saturday, while UCF is looking to get back in the win column when they face Georgia State. Following their upset over Oregon, Oklahoma State is a 57-point favorite over Murray State.

No. 11 BYU will take on Colorado State, while TCU faces Arkansas State. The latest Big 12 game is Arizona vs. Northern Illinois, who are 0-2 so far this season. That game starts at 8:30 p.m. MT. The Wildcats are 34-point favorites in that one.

articles.title: Kylian Mbappe breaks silence after ditching Nike to become 'face' of soccer at On
articles.summary: Kylian Mbappe, France’s 2026 World Cup and Real Madrid superstar, has long been a part of the Nike brand’s stable of athletes that includes all-time greats...
articles.body:
Kylian Mbappe , France's 2026 World Cup and Real Madrid superstar , has long been a part of the Nike brand's stable of athletes that includes all-time greats such as Michael Jordan, Kobe Bryant, LeBron James, and so many more. Now, he is leaving the iconic global brand to join fellow French legend Thierry Henry in endorsing an upstart Swiss shoe brand , On.

" Real Madrid striker Kylian Mbappe has quit his long-term relationship with Nike to become the face of Swiss company On's first expansion into football boots," The Athletic's Adam Crafton reports. "On has also hired former France and Arsenal star Thierry Henry as the firm's Director of Football. Henry has been secretly working in the role since 2025 and played a role in convincing Mbappe, 27, to join upon the expiration of his contract with Nike this summer."

After the news broke, Mbappe took to social media to share his first thoughts on the move from Nike to On, and those musings were quite poetic .

That might surprise you, coming from someone who plays it for a living. But it's true.

I still dream of playing with my friends. Playing until sunset. Until dinner. Playing just because it was a game, long before it could become a career.

I have followed this dream for as long as I can remember.

Once again it has led me to one of the biggest changes in my life.

Now, I find myself surrounded by innovators who dream of the same things I do.

Of bringing foot as close as possible to ball. Of bringing the people as close as possible to the game. Of bringing the world as close as possible to play.

I guess that's the thing about dreams that refuse to change. They're usually the ones that change everything.

Getting Mbappe is quite a coup for On, as the 27-year-old is one of the most famous and marketable stars in the world. It will be interesting to see if the On-Henry-Mbappe partnership can reel in any other global sensations.

articles.summary: Leeds United return to Elland Road for more Premier League action on Sunday, welcoming Crystal Palace to West Yorkshire six days after a dominant display aga...
articles.body:
Leeds United return to Elland Road for more Premier League action on Sunday, welcoming Crystal Palace to West Yorkshire six days after a dominant display against Newcastle United .

The Whites produced an emphatic performance against the Magpies, with a rampaging first-half showing setting the foundations for a memorable 4-1 victory.

Ao Tanaka opened the scoring after his effort forced an own goal from Lewis Miley , before Dominic Calvert-Lewin doubled the advantage shortly before the interval. His first was initially awarded to Jayden Bogle on the day, but was later credited to our number 9.

Noah Okafor added the finishing touch to an impressive afternoon in the second period, unleashing a thunderous half-volley to put Leeds firmly in control.

Thanks to the victory over Matthias Jaissle's side, Daniel Farke's men maintained their unbeaten start to the Premier League campaign and climbed to third in the early-season standings.

Sunday's visitors, meanwhile, have endured a more challenging opening to the campaign, collecting just one league victory from their opening four matches and suffering three defeats.

The South London outfit did enjoy a midweek boost in Europe, recording a convincing 4-0 victory over Lech Poznań in the Europa League. That result followed a disappointing Premier League outing at Selhurst Park, where they were beaten 3-2 by newly-promoted Ipswich Town.

Last season, Leeds enjoyed the better of the results, collecting four points. Most recently, Daniel Farke's side earned a point from a goalless draw on the road following an enjoyable 4-1 victory at Elland Road the December prior.

On that occasion, Dominic Calvert-Lewin struck twice, while Ethan Ampadu added a rare goal of his own before Anton Stach completed the scoring deep into stoppage time.

Pierre Sage's side currently sit 16th in the Premier League table, five points behind the Whites as they prepare to make the trip to West Yorkshire.

Action from Elland Road gets underway at 2pm.

Speaking exclusively to Premier League Studios, Justin said : "Obviously, we know we have got an advantage at Elland Road. We have the 12th man behind us and it does give you that extra few per cent that you might need to get to the ball that is a yard away or in a 50/50. We know the crowd love it and we love doing the dirty work as well.

"Hopefully we can go into it with the confidence that we showed on Monday night."

In his pre-match press conference, Daniel Farke announced that while Ilia Gruev will be available for selection against Palace, Harry Wilson has sustained a quad injury and will be sidelined for the game. Joe Rodon also remains unavailable for selection.

articles.summary: Mohamed Ali Zoma is included in Italy’s squad for the upcoming UEFA Nations League games. The Nürnberg attacker was heavily linked with a move to relegated W...
articles.body:
Mohamed Ali Zoma is included in Italy 's squad for the upcoming UEFA Nations League games. The Nürnberg attacker was heavily linked with a move to relegated West Ham United this summer after making his breakthrough in 2026.

Including five goals in as many games this season, the 22-year-old scored 15 goals in 20 2. Bundesliga appearances since the turn of the year. "Momo" has Burkina Faso and Ivory Coast roots in his family, but he has decided to represent his birth country.

Zoma joined Miroslav Klose's side from Serie C club AlbinoLeffe in August 2025. He currently has a contract until 2029 with Der Club. Roberto Mancini also included Borussia Dortmund 's Samuele Inácio in his first squad back in charge of the Italian national team.

The 18-year-old made his international debut in June as a late substitute in the narrow win over Luxembourg. His Dortmund teammate Filippo Mane was also included in that squad, but he'll now miss out as he recovers from a muscle injury.

The Euro 2020 winner has named a 34-man squad, with Zoma one of the nine new faces for Azzurri. Mancini's second spell will start at home against Belgium before a couple of games against Vincenzo Montella's Türkiye and a trip to Stade de France to face Zinedine Zidane's France.

articles.title: Tyrell Malacia transfer news: Former Manchester United left-back joins FC Cincinnati
articles.summary: FC Cincinnati sign former Manchester United left-back Tyrell Malacia on a free transfer.
articles.body:
FC Cincinnati have signed former Manchester United left-back Tyrell Malacia.

The 27-year-old Netherlands international joins the MLS club on a free transfer, having left Old Trafford at the end of last season.

Malacia arrives at Cincinnati on a deal that runs until next June, with an option to extend it for the 2027-28 season.

He made 50 appearances during an injury-hit spell with United having joined the 20-time champions of England in 2022 from Feyenoord.

"We are excited to add a player of Tyrell's experience," said Cincinnati's general manager Chris Albright.

"He's played at the highest levels of the game and understands the demands of competing in those environments.

"His quality on the ball, defensive instincts, and team-first mentality is a welcome addition to the group and we're happy to have him in Cincinnati."
